tagline.en: Scranton to Sturbridge — the road that lost its eastern half
tagline.zh: 自斯克兰顿至斯特布里奇——失去了东半段的路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-81 in Dunmore, Pennsylvania, outside Scranton
start.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州邓莫尔，斯克兰顿近郊，与 I-81 相接

end.en: I-90, the Massachusetts Turnpike, at Sturbridge, Massachusetts
end.zh: 马萨诸塞州斯特布里奇，与马萨诸塞收费高速 I-90 相接

en: The eastern I-84 crosses four states in a little over two hundred miles, from the Pennsylvania coal region through the lower Hudson Valley and central Connecticut to a junction with the Massachusetts Turnpike at Sturbridge. It is the main diagonal across southern New England, the road that connects Hartford westward to New York State and eastward to Boston-bound traffic.

Its Connecticut section is the busy part: a hilly, curving urban freeway serving Danbury, Waterbury, New Britain and Hartford, with a great deal of local commuting layered on top of through traffic. West of the Hudson it is quieter, running past Newburgh and Port Jervis into the Poconos.
It reaches neither of the places its number and shape suggest. There is no I-84 east of Sturbridge and none in Rhode Island, and the road simply hands its traffic to the Turnpike.
zh: 东段 I-84 在两百英里出头的距离内横跨四个州：自宾夕法尼亚煤区，经哈德逊河谷下游与康涅狄格中部，至斯特布里奇与马萨诸塞收费高速相交。它是南新英格兰的主要对角线通道，把哈特福德向西接往纽约州，向东接入前往波士顿的车流。
康涅狄格段是繁忙的部分：一条起伏多弯的城市高速，服务丹伯里、沃特伯里、新不列颠与哈特福德，过境交通之上还叠加了大量本地通勤。哈德逊河以西则安静得多，经纽堡与杰维斯港进入波科诺山区。
它并没有抵达其编号与走向所暗示的任何地方。斯特布里奇以东没有 I-84，罗得岛境内也没有；这条路只是把车流交给收费高速。

en: The original plan ran I-84 clear across Connecticut — Danbury, Waterbury, Hartford, Killingly — and on to Providence. In late 1968 the Federal Highway Administration approved that Hartford-to-Providence connection as a rerouted I-84, and the existing road from Manchester east to the Massachusetts Turnpike was renumbered I-86 to get it out of the way.

The extension died in the water supply. Rhode Island's section threatened the Scituate Reservoir, which supplies much of the state, and the state withdrew its sixteen miles from the Interstate System in September 1983. Connecticut withdrew its own segments days later: 28.8 miles between Bolton and Coventry and between Windham and Killingly, plus a further 4.7 miles to the Rhode Island line. A 4.4-mile piece between the two withdrawn segments had already been built and opened, could not be withdrawn, and was simply deleted from the system.

Route continuity was restored by putting I-84 back on the road to Sturbridge. The I-86 designation was deleted on 12 December 1984, and the built-but-orphaned Manchester spur became I-384. Hartford and Providence, two state capitals about seventy miles apart, still have no freeway between them.
zh: 最初的方案是让 I-84 横穿整个康涅狄格州——丹伯里、沃特伯里、哈特福德、基林利——再继续通往普罗维登斯。1968 年末，联邦公路管理局批准把哈特福德至普罗维登斯的这条连接线作为改线后的 I-84，而自曼彻斯特向东至马萨诸塞收费高速的既有道路则改编号为 I-86，以腾出编号。
这条延伸线最终倒在了水源问题上。罗得岛州境内的路段威胁到为该州大部分地区供水的西楚埃特水库，该州遂于 1983 年 9 月将其 16 英里从州际公路系统中撤出。数日后康涅狄格州也撤出了自己的路段：博尔顿至考文垂、温德姆至基林利共 28.8 英里，另有通往罗得岛州界的 4.7 英里。两段撤出路段之间有 4.4 英里已经建成通车，无法撤出，于是干脆从系统中删除。
路线的连续性靠把 I-84 改回通往斯特布里奇的那条路来恢复。I-86 编号于 1984 年 12 月 12 日取消，而那段已建成却被孤立的曼彻斯特支线成了 I-384。哈特福德与普罗维登斯这两座相距约七十英里的州首府，至今之间没有高速公路。

en: The hardest asset on the route is the Mixmaster, the stacked interchange where I-84 crosses Route 8 above downtown Waterbury and the Naugatuck River. It opened in 1968, and its steel and decks have reached the point where maintenance buys time rather than condition.

Connecticut spent five years and a large sum rehabilitating it, finishing in 2023, to add about twenty-five years of life. The department's own analysis found that doing the same again in 2045 would cost roughly as much as a replacement without improving how the interchange works, so the plan is to replace it outright in the 2030s or 2040s. Two alternatives are under study, both an order of magnitude more expensive than the rehabilitation.
zh: 本路线上最棘手的资产是「搅拌机」（Mixmaster）：I-84 与 Route 8 在沃特伯里市中心与诺格塔克河上方交汇的多层立交。它于 1968 年通车，如今其钢结构与桥面已到了养护只能换取时间、换不来状况改善的地步。
康涅狄格州为翻修它花了五年时间与一大笔钱，于 2023 年完工，为其增加约二十五年寿命。该州交通部自己的分析认为，若在 2045 年再做一次同样的事，费用将与整体重建相当，却无法改善立交的通行功能；因此计划是在 2030 年代或 2040 年代直接拆除重建。目前有两个方案在研究，造价都比这次翻修高一个数量级。

label.en: Value of the withdrawn Connecticut extension
label.zh: 康涅狄格州撤出路段的核定价值

value.en: $404.9 million final withdrawal value for 33.5 miles between Bolton and the Rhode Island line, of which $349.1 million was reobligated to substitute highway projects and $1.5 million to transit
value.zh: 博尔顿至罗得岛州界 33.5 英里路段的最终撤出价值为 4.049 亿美元，其中 3.491 亿美元改投替代公路项目、150 万美元投入公共交通

figures.source: FHWA Highway History, Interstate Withdrawal-Substitution Program, Connecticut I-84 Bolton to Killingly

label.en: Value of the withdrawn Rhode Island section
label.zh: 罗得岛州撤出路段的核定价值

figures.source: FHWA Highway History, Interstate Withdrawal-Substitution Program, summary table

label.zh: 沃特伯里「搅拌机」立交翻修

value.en: $223.7 million, begun in 2018 and completed in 2023, extending the interchange's life by about 25 years
value.zh: 2.237 亿美元，2018 年开工、2023 年完工，为该立交延寿约 25 年

figures.source: Connecticut Department of Transportation completion announcement, as reported by CT Insider

label.zh: 沃特伯里「搅拌机」立交重建估算

value.en: $3 billion to $5 billion in 2022 dollars for either of the two shortlisted alternatives; a further rehabilitation in 2045 was costed at about $1 billion in 2017 dollars and rejected as not worth it
value.zh: 两个入围方案均为 30 亿至 50 亿美元（2022 年美元）；另有一次 2045 年再翻修的方案，估算约 10 亿美元（2017 年美元），因不值得而被否决

figures.source: Connecticut Department of Transportation, The New Mix programme alternatives analysis

value.en: 232.40 miles: 97.90 in Connecticut, 71.41 in New York, 54.88 in Pennsylvania and 8.21 in Massachusetts
value.zh: 232.40 英里：康涅狄格州 97.90 英里，纽约州 71.41 英里，宾夕法尼亚州 54.88 英里，马萨诸塞州 8.21 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026, summing the four eastern states listed under I-84

why.en: Four state transportation departments publish counts by segment, and the Connecticut urban sections are not comparable with the Pennsylvania end. No route-wide figure is published.
why.zh: 四个州的交通部门按路段发布交通量，康涅狄格的城市路段与宾夕法尼亚一端无从比较。未发布全线数字。

timeline.en: The Waterbury Mixmaster interchange opens; the FHWA approves rerouting I-84 from Hartford to Providence.
timeline.zh: 沃特伯里「搅拌机」立交通车；联邦公路管理局批准将 I-84 改线经哈特福德通往普罗维登斯。

timeline.en: The existing road from Manchester to the Massachusetts Turnpike is renumbered I-86.
timeline.zh: 自曼彻斯特至马萨诸塞收费高速的既有道路改编号为 I-86。

timeline.en: Rhode Island and then Connecticut withdraw the Hartford–Providence extension from the Interstate System.
timeline.zh: 罗得岛州继而康涅狄格州将哈特福德—普罗维登斯延伸线撤出州际公路系统。

timeline.en: The I-86 designation is deleted on 12 December and I-84 returns to the Sturbridge alignment.
timeline.zh: 12 月 12 日，I-86 编号取消，I-84 回到通往斯特布里奇的线位。

timeline.en: Connecticut completes a five-year rehabilitation of the Mixmaster.
timeline.zh: 康涅狄格州完成历时五年的「搅拌机」立交翻修。
